sql_reading_A.sql:
SELECT
    r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS BUILDING_NAME,
    r.FLOOR,
    r.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    100.0 * r.AREA / NULLIF(f.EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0) AS ROOM_PERCENT_OF_FLOOR,
    100.0 * r.AREA / NULLIF(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0) AS ROOM_PERCENT_OF_BUILDING
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f
    ON r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT d
    ON r.DEPT_CODE = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE;

sql_reading_B.sql:
SELECT
    r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS BUILDING_NAME,
    r.FLOOR,
    r.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    100.0 * r.AREA / NULLIF(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) AS ROOM_PERCENT_OF_FLOOR,
    100.0 * r.AREA / NULLIF(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) AS ROOM_PERCENT_OF_BUILDING
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f
    ON r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT d
    ON r.DEPT_CODE = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE;
